card.name: Digits inside long numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, most often 8, partway through a multi-digit number such as a price, phone number, or company registration number. Also fires on the word International inside a company name.

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A single digit in the middle of a price, phone number, or registration number.
modes.example: TSL Education Ltd Registered in England (No 020172<<8>>9) at 26 Red Lion

modes.label: International in a company name
modes.description: The word International inside a Chinese company name.
modes.example: involving the China Henan<< International>> Cooperation Group in
